CAS Evidence Credit Detail

wmtpa@conduent.com is for evidence submission only. This email is not monitored, and emails sent will not be responded to. Conduent receives and retains all physical evidence, then digitally uploads the evidence to Walmart Claims Services.

casfaq@walmart.comis for questions about evidence efficiency or charges. Note that evidence is not available for review until it has been uploaded from Conduent to Walmart Claims Services.

Case Managers are associates at Walmart Claims Services that determine the liability of the claim. They do not process the evidence or review it for evidence efficiency.

The review period for each claim Bodily Injury is 17 calendar days from the claim open date. All evidence must be received by Conduent (not Casfaq or the Case Manager) on or before the 17th day. Late evidence is not able to affect the grade.

The review period for each Garage Keeper - Property Damage claim is 5 calendar days from the claim open date. All evidence must be received by Conduent (not Casfaq or the Case Manager) on or before the 5th day. Late evidence is not able to affect the grade.

Note: All statements must be written on the correct store reports and filled out by the correct parties. All explanations for incomplete/lacking evidence must be listed on the Evidence Collection Sheet.

Links to further relevant information are listed below.

  • Customer Code White (Documentation) Job Aid
  • Associate Code White (Documentation) Job Aid
  • Claims Allocation Program

Facilities will receive one of the following emails after processing has completed: A notification alert indicating that evidence is missing; or a notification alert indicating all evidence has been received and accepted. There is no need to follow up with WCS until one of the above emails has been transmitted.

The Enhanced Export column indicates if Export Reporter was used to upload video to Conduent. This column does not indicate whether the video has been deemed efficient. Refer to the 'video' column for efficiency details.
